title: OpenAI ChatGPT fixes DNS data smuggling flaw • The Register
summary: Check Point discovered a data exfiltration vulnerability in ChatGPT, where a malicious prompt could bypass safeguards and leak data through DNS. OpenAI fixed the issue on February 20, 2026.
sentiment_reason: The vulnerability and its potential for serious implications in regulated industries, such as violating GDPR or HIPAA, contribute to a negative market impact.
